notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Car Dealers![/h2]

Here comes the [b]Collectibles Update[/b]! With this patch, you can now craft trophies, collect them, and proudly display them in your office.

[h3]What’s new?[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]New junkyard station - car crusher[/b]
Prepare a car that’s 100% mechanically functional. It must be also rust-free, washed, and polished. Once it meets all requirements, you can crush it into a trophy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/7101297d74e995519199455b2e4ac4fccaecf3e6.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Trophies with multiple tiers[/b]

Show off your crafted trophies in the office and impress your clients with your collection. Shelves are available in level 3 and 4 offices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/bb6f17b9db95bf55c6345883bdfe580df4a3df86.gif[/img]
 
[*] [b]New vehicle info app[/b]
A full vehicle encyclopedia has been added – you’ll find descriptions of every car, fun facts, and the new statistics feature. From now on, you can track things like: number of cars bought, kilometers driven, fuel consumed, and more. Stats are tracked starting from this patch, so your achievements begin now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/5aa9e04852d0a916bd141a9a4779c3282e5cf4af.png[/img]

[/list]

Enjoy the new possibilities and show off your trophies to your clients!

In today’s devlog, we wanted to summarize how the online shop and delivery system work - some of which we've already teased in previous posts.

[h3]🛒 24/7 Shopping with Delivery[/h3]
Plan your purchases wisely! Unlike the physical store, the online shop and delivery system are available 24/7, but the delivery fee is [b]$500[/b].
Each order can contain up to [b]100 items[/b].

Once you place an order, a delivery truck will head your way.

When the truck arrives, you’ll get a notification on your HUD.
Interact with the trailer - once the doors are open, you’ll have access to the packages.
You can [b]pick them up and move them around freely[/b].
With a package in hand, you can enter [b]item transfer mode[/b] to move items from the package into your inventory.
If you're holding a package and interact with the storage room, you can [b]transfer its contents directly to storage[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/d5256fb3c8187b7111f3e19ff8df6c18e57b4071.png[/img]

Until now, the junkyard allowed you to:
[list]
[*] Buy and sell used parts,
[*] Occasionally find abandoned vehicles impounded by the police (as informed by emails from Ron Dunn),
[*] Purchase a tow truck.
[/list]

[h3]In this devlog, we’re giving you a sneak peek at [b]some of the new junkyard features[/b].[/h3]

First of all, you’ll now be able to [b]sell non-functional vehicles[/b] at the junkyard.
As you might remember, it was already possible to sell such cars from your Car Dealer lot - but doing so would cost you reputation points. If you have broken cars with missing parts and don’t want to repair them, now you can sell them safely at the junkyard [b]without losing reputation[/b].

The junkyard owner has lower expectations than regular customers - but there’s [b]no haggling[/b] involved. notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, Car Dealers! 🚗[/h2]
The release of our free prologue is [b]only 3 days[/b] away! If you haven’t added our game to your wishlist yet, now is the perfect time to do so! 😊

In today’s devlog, we want to showcase some key locations on the Winston Springs map that you’ll be able to explore during gameplay.

[h2]1. Car Parts Store 🛠️[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138655/3c863abbd404ef564ae2e5e110cead559b0eca0b.jpg[/img]

This is where you’ll stock up on essential parts for car repairs. The store offers a variety of car parts, cleaning products, and tools for quick fixes. It’s perfect for getting cars back in shape and ready for sale!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138655/b07900cead89f09543a91e696dbfc5d144dcda15.gif[/img]

[h2]2. Gas Station ⛽[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138655/a3cb6e4ac7946f3556ebd9c8e6a1014db011675a.jpg[/img]

Vehicles in Car Dealer Simulator need fuel to get moving! This is where you’ll fill up your cars. In the future, the gas station will also function as a shop, where you’ll be able to buy various items that can be incredibly helpful during negotiations with stubborn customers. Additionally, you’ll find small car repair parts here that you’ll always want to have on hand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138655/a2efcea390ba0c2f35b4be7aca88a679c36c6058.gif[/img]

[h2]3. Your Company Headquarters 🏢[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138655/771c4862e64372b56e44fe83113679aeb25f691b.jpg[/img]

This is the heart of your business. Here, you’ll find everything you need to manage your operations: a workshop, car wash, sales lot, office, and a place to relax. As you progress in the game, your headquarters will grow – each wing will offer new opportunities and unique upgrades. The evolving infrastructure will influence how you manage cars and customers, and will help you build your automotive empire!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138655/0a03162776137fd2698f74378856b0da3ffb94e4.gif[/img]

These are just a few of the many exciting locations waiting for you in the game. If you’re ready for an adventure in the world of car dealerships, make sure to add our prologue to your wishlist now!
See you in Winston Springs! 🚙💨
